hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler Finance vault positions, bypassing Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity. It implements a configurable bonding curve, taking input tokens into Euler vault deposits and withdrawing output tokens directly from vaults, while enforcing a curve invariant on reserves. Add-liquidity and donate are blocked to prevent idle or irrecoverable funds.
